name: Beth
bio:
Nurse🩺 Born and raised in the heartland of Nebraska, I've got Midwestern values and a down-to-earth attitude❤️

Looking for someone who appreciates loyalty, kindness, and a good laugh. Swipe right if you're ready for some genuine connections and late-night chats over a cup of warm tea ☕

name: Suzie
bio:
